# How to make AI parody videos of movie scenes and public figures

**A known scene, one wrong element and a payoff become a 10-45 second parody, with six measured formats and the rules for real people.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_350a40cd23d4.webp" alt="A mockumentary office sketch from one prompt: a wizard points a wand at a printer, a deadpan colleague holds a mug, then the wizard talks to the camera." width="480"></p>

Plan and make a short AI parody video: a known movie scene, TV format or news shot with one wrong element, 10 to 45 seconds, built to be shared. Gives the joke structure, six formats measured on clips with 60 thousand to 9 million views (scene recast with new dialogue, original-vs-remake, one-prompt sitcom sketch, fake live news shot, character monologue, silent slapstick), which production route each one takes, prompt templates for the sketch and the news shot, subtitle and caption rules, and a plain list of what is allowed with real people, known characters, studio footage and cloned voices, with platform AI labels. Use when someone asks for a parody, spoof, meme video, movie mashup, crossover, "X in the world of Y", a celebrity or politician comedy clip, a fake trailer, or wants videos like the viral AI parodies on X, TikTok or Shorts. Then use scene-recast-video for remakes of an existing clip and multi-angle-monologue for speeches.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill ai-parody-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills ai-parody-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | measured: $0.96 for a 12 s one-prompt sketch; $3.00 for a 10 s recast |

## Ask your agent

- "Plan a 30-second parody: a startup founder gets the mentor's street speech from a 1999 sci-fi film, about this week's AI news"
- "Write a one-prompt mockumentary office sketch about prompt engineering, 15 seconds, with a look-to-camera button"
- "Is it OK to put a politician in my parody video? Tell me what is allowed and how to label it"
